title: Capability interface on omp, described by the runtime
situation: omp's convention for extension tools: an extension registers each tool with a snake_case name, a label, a description, a parameter schema whose fields are each described, and an approval tier of read, write or exec. Decision 0032 placed the descriptions in the adapter, which restates the capability's meaning outside the capability.
decision: The runtime explains its own interface: cratylus <capability> --explain gives the whole capability and cratylus <capability> <verb> --explain one verb, as data: name, purpose, when to reach for it, each parameter with its schema and description, and whether the verb only reads or appends; the command's own help is drawn from the same source. One cratylus omp extension registers each capability as one tool, composing the runtime's explanation into omp's contract without adding to it, and calls the runtime for every act. Read-only verbs are declared read, appending verbs write.
consequences: Cut 6 realizes it for the concept journal. Supporting another harness means composing the same explanation into its contract.
